title: Software Engineer
summary: Master coding fundamentals, build production projects, and prepare for software engineering roles.

tasks.label: Learn programming fundamentals
tasks.detail: Choose a primary language (Python/Java/JS) and practice basics: control flow, data types, and functions.

tasks.label: Understand data structures & algorithms
tasks.detail: Study arrays, lists, trees, graphs, sorting, and complexity analysis for interview success.

tasks.label: Build 3+ real projects
tasks.detail: Create and deploy small apps that demonstrate front-end, back-end or full-stack skills.

tasks.label: Use version control
tasks.detail: Master Git workflows: branches, pull requests, rebasing, and collaborative development on GitHub.

tasks.label: Learn testing & debugging
tasks.detail: Write unit and integration tests and use debuggers/logging to troubleshoot issues.

tasks.label: Practice system design basics
tasks.detail: Study components, APIs, databases, caching and scaling concepts for mid-level roles.

tasks.label: Complete internships or freelance work
tasks.detail: Gain real-world experience through internships, part-time jobs, or freelance projects.

tasks.label: Prepare for technical interviews
tasks.detail: Solve timed coding problems and rehearse behavioral interview answers.

tasks.label: Polish your portfolio and resume
tasks.detail: Document project case studies, architecture decisions, and code links for recruiters.

tasks.label: Apply and negotiate offers
tasks.detail: Apply broadly, practice interview feedback, and evaluate compensation and growth opportunities.

title: AI/ML Engineer
summary: Develop practical machine learning skills, build ML projects, and prepare for ML engineering roles.

tasks.label: Strengthen math & statistics fundamentals
tasks.detail: Master linear algebra, calculus basics, probability, and statistics for model understanding.

tasks.label: Master Python for ML
tasks.detail: Learn NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, and workflow patterns for experimentation.

tasks.label: Study core ML algorithms
tasks.detail: Understand supervised/unsupervised algorithms, evaluation metrics and model selection.

tasks.label: Learn deep learning basics
tasks.detail: Work with neural networks using frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch for applied tasks.

tasks.label: Build reproducible ML projects
tasks.detail: Ship end-to-end pipelines: data ingestion, training, evaluation and deployment.

tasks.label: Learn deployment & MLOps basics
tasks.detail: Understand model serving, scaling, CI/CD for ML, and model monitoring.

tasks.label: Participate in competitions & datasets
tasks.detail: Solve problems on Kaggle or public datasets to sharpen modeling instincts.

tasks.label: Publish a project with reproducible code
tasks.detail: Open-source a notebook or repo with clear instructions and results.

tasks.label: Complete internships or research experience
tasks.detail: Gain practical exposure through internships, co-ops or university research.

tasks.label: Prepare ML interview topics
tasks.detail: Study model tradeoffs, system design for ML, and ML-specific coding questions.

title: Data Scientist
summary: Analyze data, build models, and communicate insights to drive decisions.

tasks.label: Master statistics and EDA
tasks.detail: Perform exploratory data analysis and learn hypothesis testing and sampling.

tasks.label: Learn Python & data libraries
tasks.detail: Use pandas, NumPy, matplotlib/seaborn and data cleaning patterns effectively.

tasks.label: Practice SQL for analytics
tasks.detail: Write complex queries, joins and window functions to extract business data.

tasks.label: Model building and evaluation
tasks.detail: Train models, validate with cross-validation, and interpret performance metrics.

tasks.label: Build storytelling dashboards
tasks.detail: Create dashboards and visual narratives that explain impact to stakeholders.

tasks.label: Work on domain-specific datasets
tasks.detail: Practice with industry datasets and tailor features to business problems.

tasks.label: Create reproducible analyses
tasks.detail: Package analyses with notebooks, scripts and README for reproducibility.

tasks.label: Gain practical experience
tasks.detail: Intern or consult on data projects that deliver measurable outcomes.

tasks.label: Publish a portfolio project
tasks.detail: Share a case study with code, data pipeline and visualization for hiring.

tasks.label: Prepare analytics interviews
tasks.detail: Practice SQL, statistics, product-sense questions and presentation skills.

title: Full Stack Developer
summary: Deliver end-to-end applications by mastering both frontend and backend development.

tasks.label: Learn frontend fundamentals
tasks.detail: Understand HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and responsive UI patterns.

tasks.label: Master a frontend framework
tasks.detail: Build interfaces using React, Vue, or Angular with state management.

tasks.label: Learn backend basics
tasks.detail: Understand RESTful APIs, routing, authentication and database interactions.

tasks.label: Work with databases
tasks.detail: Design schemas and write efficient queries for SQL or NoSQL databases.

tasks.label: Build full-stack projects
tasks.detail: Ship at least 2 end-to-end apps with deployment and CI/CD.

tasks.label: Use version control and collaboration
tasks.detail: Collaborate using Git, code reviews and feature branching.

tasks.label: Implement authentication & security
tasks.detail: Add secure auth, input validation, and protect sensitive data.

tasks.label: Optimize performance
tasks.detail: Profile apps, reduce bundle size, and add caching where needed.

tasks.label: Deploy and monitor apps
tasks.detail: Use cloud or container platforms to deploy and monitor application health.

tasks.label: Prepare for interviews and land a role
tasks.detail: Showcase projects, practice system design and solve coding challenges.

title: DevOps Engineer
summary: Automate infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines and ensure reliable deployments.

tasks.label: Learn Linux and networking basics
tasks.detail: Understand OS fundamentals, networking, firewalls and SSH.

tasks.label: Master containers and orchestration
tasks.detail: Use Docker and Kubernetes for packaging and scaling services.

tasks.label: Understand CI/CD pipelines
tasks.detail: Implement automated builds, tests and deployments with a pipeline tool.

tasks.label: Work with cloud providers
tasks.detail: Deploy and manage services on AWS, GCP or Azure and learn cost considerations.

tasks.label: Learn IaC (Infrastructure as Code)
tasks.detail: Use Terraform or CloudFormation to declare, version and apply infrastructure.

tasks.label: Implement monitoring and alerts
tasks.detail: Integrate observability stacks (logs, metrics, tracing) for production systems.

tasks.label: Automate repetitive tasks
tasks.detail: Use scripting and tooling to reduce manual operations and increase reliability.

tasks.label: Practice incident response
tasks.detail: Simulate incidents and learn post-mortem and remediation practices.

tasks.label: Gain practical experience via projects
tasks.detail: Build and operate a small production-like environment for learning.

tasks.label: Prepare for role-specific interviews
tasks.detail: Review system architecture, deployment patterns and troubleshooting scenarios.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
summary: Protect systems by learning security fundamentals, monitoring threats, and responding to incidents.

tasks.label: Learn security fundamentals
tasks.detail: Understand confidentiality, integrity, availability and basic cryptography.

tasks.label: Master networking and OS concepts
tasks.detail: Study TCP/IP, common services and vulnerabilities in OSs and networks.

tasks.label: Familiarize with security tools
tasks.detail: Use tools like Wireshark, Nmap, and basic SIEM platforms for analysis.

tasks.label: Practice threat detection
tasks.detail: Set up simple detection rules and learn to investigate suspicious activity.

tasks.label: Complete labs or CTFs
tasks.detail: Participate in capture-the-flag events or online labs to build practical skills.

tasks.label: Study incident response
tasks.detail: Practice triage, containment, eradication and recovery steps.

tasks.label: Gain certifications if needed
tasks.detail: Consider entry-level certs like CompTIA Security+ or vendor certs depending on goals.

tasks.label: Get hands-on experience
tasks.detail: Intern with security teams or contribute to security tooling projects.

tasks.label: Document and communicate findings
tasks.detail: Write clear incident reports and remediation steps for stakeholders.

tasks.label: Prepare for security role interviews
tasks.detail: Study common attack patterns, defense techniques and case studies.

title: UI/UX Designer
summary: Design user experiences by learning research, wireframing, prototyping and usability testing.

tasks.label: Learn design fundamentals
tasks.detail: Study layout, color, typography and visual hierarchy principles.

tasks.label: Practice user research
tasks.detail: Conduct simple interviews, surveys and synthesize findings into insights.

tasks.label: Create wireframes and flows
tasks.detail: Sketch user journeys and low-fidelity screens for product ideas.

tasks.label: Master a prototyping tool
tasks.detail: Use Figma or similar tools to create interactive prototypes and handoffs.

tasks.label: Perform usability testing
tasks.detail: Test prototypes with users and iterate based on feedback.

tasks.label: Build case-study portfolio
tasks.detail: Document problem, constraints, design process and outcome for each project.

tasks.label: Collaborate with engineers
tasks.detail: Practice clear handoffs and use design systems for consistent implementations.

tasks.label: Learn accessibility basics
tasks.detail: Ensure designs support keyboard navigation, contrast and assistive tech where possible.

tasks.label: Collect feedback and iterate
tasks.detail: Use analytics and user feedback to refine product experiences.

tasks.label: Publish your portfolio and apply
tasks.detail: Share polished case studies and apply for internships or junior roles.

title: Chartered Accountant
summary: Become proficient in accounting, taxation, auditing and professional practice.

tasks.label: Learn accounting fundamentals
tasks.detail: Master journal entries, ledgers, financial statements and basics of bookkeeping.

tasks.label: Study taxation
tasks.detail: Understand direct and indirect tax laws, returns and compliance basics.

tasks.label: Practice auditing principles
tasks.detail: Learn about internal controls, evidence and audit procedures.

tasks.label: Complete required articleship
tasks.detail: Gain hands-on experience under a practicing CA through articleship training.

tasks.label: Prepare for professional exams
tasks.detail: Study and practice past papers for CA exams with disciplined revision.

tasks.label: Work on case studies
tasks.detail: Solve practical accounting and taxation problems to improve application skills.

tasks.label: Build client communication skills
tasks.detail: Practice explaining financial concepts and compliance requirements to clients.

tasks.label: Learn accounting software

tasks.label: Network professionally
tasks.detail: Connect with firms and mentors to find growth opportunities and guidance.

tasks.label: Plan continuous professional development
tasks.detail: Identify post-qualification specializations like tax, forensic accounting, or advisory.

title: MBA Graduate
summary: Gain strategic business knowledge, leadership skills and placement readiness through an MBA.

tasks.label: Understand MBA specializations
tasks.detail: Explore specializations (finance, marketing, operations) and choose a focus area.

tasks.label: Develop quantitative skills
tasks.detail: Practice finance, statistics and Excel skills commonly used in business analysis.

tasks.label: Work on case studies
tasks.detail: Solve real business cases to build problem-solving and presentation skills.

tasks.label: Build leadership and teamwork skills

tasks.label: Network with alumni and recruiters

tasks.label: Create CVs and interview practice

tasks.label: Develop domain expertise
tasks.detail: Undertake projects that demonstrate functional depth in your chosen area.

tasks.label: Learn data-driven decision making
tasks.detail: Use analytics and business intelligence tools for strategic insights.

tasks.label: Secure placement or entrepreneurial plan

title: Investment Banker

tasks.label: Master Excel and modeling

tasks.label: Complete internships in finance
tasks.detail: Gain experience through internships at banks or advisory firms.

tasks.label: Build case studies and pitchbooks
tasks.detail: Document transaction case studies and prepare client pitch materials.

tasks.label: Network and attend industry events

tasks.label: Prepare technical and fit interviews
tasks.detail: Practice financial questions, market awareness and behavioral interviews.

tasks.label: Understand regulatory environment

tasks.label: Polish communication and presentation skills

tasks.label: Evaluate offers and career path

title: Financial Analyst
